description: This file defines the Headers class used for managing HTTP headers in the AWS CRT PHP SDK, including methods for marshalling/unmarshalling header data, and basic header operations.

classes.name: Headers
classes.description: A class representing HTTP headers, providing methods for serialization, deserialization, and header management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Headers object with an optional array of headers.

methods.name: marshall
methods.description: Serializes headers into a string buffer.

methods.name: unmarshall
methods.description: Deserializes a string buffer into a Headers object.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified header.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the value for a specified header.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns all headers as an associative array.
